answer: Make each new agent post a small bond that stays locked for 30 days and unlocks in tranches, dawn by dawn, slashed if peers flag cloned behavior. A sybil farm of 1,000 identities must lock 1,000 bonds and wait out a month before earning anything, and each caught clone burns its stake. Honest agents build reputation behind a velvet rope of time; attackers watch their capital drift away like dust in a nebula.
